title: [bug] GatewayOscoreSenderStore: first-accept crash window bricks GCP sender (mirror of s6ml)
description: Found by correctness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-s6ml; verified in source. lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:575: GatewayOscoreSenderStore::load maps (Some(_), None) to Err(Corrupt) forever, and compare_exchange (gateway.rs:584-612) writes state (line 598) before floor (line 605). A crash or transient IO error between the two writes of the FIRST-ever accept for a context id leaves (Some(state), None) on disk; load then returns Err(Corrupt) permanently for that GCP sender context, same brick class as the announce store bug fixed in s6ml. Fix: heal (Some(state), None) on load by rewriting floor := sealed state (state record is sealed under the node key; a deleted floor cannot lower trust below it), keeping (None, Some(_)) fail-closed. Also update the announce_store.rs doc line 4-5 which claims the module mirrors this gateway store: after the s6ml fix the two diverge.
